newsitem.title: ESTONIA: PORT OF TALLINN H1 PROFIT UP TO 77 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: PORT OF TALLINN H1 PROFIT UP TO 77 MLN KROONS.

text.p: The Port of Tallinn's pre-tax profit was 77 million kroons in the first half compared with 51 million for the same period in 1996, the port said on Monday.
Net sales reached 381.6 million kroons for the first six months of 1997 compared to 431 million kroons for first half of 1996, the compnay said in a statement.
"The decrease in sales was due to the sale of some terminals to private companies in the beginning of the year," Sandor Liive, finance director for the port, told Reuters.
"Last year we used to lease the terminals out," he added.
